cleaned_text: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Official Scheme Page HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund AMC: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited Category: Mid Cap Fund - An open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid-cap stocks. Fund Type: Open-Ended Equity Scheme Launch Date: June 25, 2007 Plan Options: Direct Plan and Regular Plan, available in Growth and IDCW (Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal) options. Net Asset Value (NAV) & Assets Under Management (AUM) Net Asset Value (NAV): As of June 01, 2026, the Net Asset Value (NAV) for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is Rs. 182.45 for the Direct Plan and Rs. 165.20 for the Regular Plan. Assets Under Management (AUM): As of April 30, 2026, the Assets Under Management (AUM) for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is Rs. 65,420 Crores. NAV History: The NAV of the Direct Plan was Rs. 150.32 on June 01, 2025, Rs. 98.75 on June 01, 2023, and Rs. 45.60 on June 01, 2019. Fund Manager The fund is managed by Mr. Chirag Setalvad , who has been associated with HDFC Asset Management since 2007. Mr. Setalvad holds an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad (IIM-A) and has over 20 years of experience in the financial services industry. He also manages the HDFC Small Cap Fund and HDFC Infrastructure Fund. His investment philosophy focuses on identifying quality mid-cap companies with strong growth potential, clean corporate governance, and sustainable competitive advantages. Scheme Suitability & Riskometer This product is suitable for investors who are seeking long-term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in equity and equity-related instruments of mid-cap companies. The riskometer for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is classified as Very High . Investors should have an investment horizon of at least 5-7 years. This fund is not suitable for investors seeking short-term gains or capital preservation. Benchmark The benchmark index for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is the Nifty Midcap 150 TRI (Total Returns Index). The fund's performance is evaluated against this benchmark on a rolling basis across 1-year, 3-year, 5-year, and since-inception periods. Historical Returns & Performance The following are the historical returns for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund (Direct Plan) as of May 31, 2026: 1-Year Return: 21.38% (Benchmark: 18.92%) 3-Year Return (CAGR): 24.56% (Benchmark: 22.10%) 5-Year Return (CAGR): 22.85% (Benchmark: 20.45%) 10-Year Return (CAGR): 18.72% (Benchmark: 16.90%) Since Inception Return (CAGR): 20.15% (Benchmark: 17.80%) Note: Past performance may or may not be sustained in the future. Returns are calculated on a CAGR basis for periods greater than one year. Portfolio Composition & Sector Allocation As of April 30, 2026, the portfolio of HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund holds approximately 65 stocks across various sectors. The key sector allocation is as follows: Financial Services: 18.5% Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals: 14.2% Information Technology: 12.8% Consumer Discretionary: 11.5% Industrials & Capital Goods: 10.3% Chemicals: 8.7% Automobile & Auto Ancillaries: 7.4% Others: 16.6% Top 5 holdings include: Persistent Systems Ltd (4.2%), Max Healthcare Institute Ltd (3.8%), Indian Hotels Co Ltd (3.5%), The Federal Bank Ltd (3.2%), and Coforge Ltd (3.0%). Investment Details & Minimum Amounts Minimum SIP Amount: Rs. 100 per month and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Initial Investment (Lumpsum): Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Additional Purchase: Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. SIP Frequency Options: Monthly, Quarterly, and Weekly SIP options are available. SIP Date Options: Investors can choose any date from the 1st to 28th of the month for SIP deductions. Expense Ratio As of April 30, 2026, the Expense Ratio for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is as follows: Direct Plan: 0.85% per annum Regular Plan: 1.55% per annum The expense ratio includes management fees, administration costs, and other operational expenses. It is charged on a daily accrual basis and is deducted from the fund's NAV. Exit Load Details The exit load structure for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is defined as follows: For redemption/switch-out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: 1.00% of the applicable NAV. For redemption/switch-out after 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: Nil . Exit load is calculated on the applicable NAV on the date of redemption. No exit load is charged on units allotted via dividend reinvestment. Tax Implications The tax treatment for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund is as per the prevailing Income Tax Act, 1961, as amended from time to time: Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG): If units are sold within 12 months of purchase, gains are classified as short-term and taxed at 20% (plus applicable surcharge and cess). Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG): If units are sold after 12 months, gains exceeding Rs. 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5% (plus applicable surcharge and cess) without the benefit of indexation. Dividend Distribution: Dividends (IDCW) are added to the investor's income and taxed at their applicable income tax slab rate. TDS of 10% is deducted if dividends exceed Rs. 5,000 in a financial year. SIP Calculator & Wealth Creation A monthly SIP of Rs. 10,000 in the Direct Plan of HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund, started 10 years ago, would have grown to approximately Rs. 31.5 Lakhs (total investment of Rs. 12 Lakhs), representing an annualized return (XIRR) of approximately 19.5%. A monthly SIP of Rs. 5,000 started 5 years ago would have grown to approximately Rs. 5.2 Lakhs (total investment of Rs. 3 Lakhs). Risk Factors Investments in HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund are subject to the following risk factors: Market Risk: NAV may fluctuate due to changes in market conditions, interest rates, and economic factors. Liquidity Risk: Mid-cap stocks may have lower trading volumes, potentially impacting the ability to sell holdings at desired prices. Concentration Risk: The portfolio may have concentrated positions in certain sectors or stocks, increasing volatility. Regulatory Risk: Changes in government policies, tax regulations, or SEBI guidelines may impact the fund's operations and returns. How to Invest Investors can invest in HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund through the following channels: HDFC Mutual Fund official website (www.hdfcfund.com) HDFC Mutual Fund mobile app Authorized distributors and financial advisors Online investment platforms such as Groww, Zerodha Coin, and Kuvera AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributors (MFDs) Last updated from sources: June 01, 2026.
